title: SHSU vs TexasState: tuition, size, accreditation

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Sam Houston State University (SHSU) and Texas State University are both public institutions, but they differ in several key aspects. SHSU, located in Huntsville, has an undergraduate enrollment of 17,743 students, whereas Texas State University in San Marcos enrolls 36,177 undergraduates. Tuition for in-state students at SHSU is $9,228, which is lower compared to Texas State's in-state tuition of $11,450. These differences in size, location, and cost highlight the distinct characteristics of SHSU vs Texas State.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance between Sam Houston State University (SHSU) and Texas State University, SHSU offers a lower tuition rate for both in-state and out-of-state students. In-state tuition at SHSU is $9,228, while Texas State charges $11,450 for in-state students. For out-of-state students, SHSU's tuition is $19,068 compared to Texas State's $22,930. Regarding student debt, the median debt for graduates who completed their programs at SHSU is $21,983, slightly higher than Texas State's median debt of $21,000. These figures provide a financial perspective on SHSU vs Texas State, reflecting differences in tuition costs and graduate debt levels.
